title: Common-source naturality of cycle-compatible homology evaluation
statement: Let C be a small category, S a Grothendieck topology and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let A,E,L,K be integer cochain complexes of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], n an integer, q:L->A and p:L->E arbitrary cochain maps. Write Qmap:H^n(Hom(A,K))->H^n(Hom(L,K)) and Pmap:H^n(Hom(E,K))->H^n(Hom(L,K)) for precomposition [def-pur-hom-complex], and suppose Pmap is invertible. Supply a family pi of degreewise Hom-component maps for all source and target complexes and integer degrees, satisfying the Hom differential formula and pre/postcomposition naturality from [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Let g,d and f,c be evaluations on Hom(A,K) and Hom(E,K) homology and cycles respectively. For each pair assume the two cycle factorization identities using the supplied (-n,0) component pi [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]: cycle inclusion agrees with projected evaluation on source cycles, and target homology projection agrees with evaluation on source homology. Then g;Hom(H^(-n)(q),1)=Qmap;Pmap.inverse;f;Hom(H^(-n)(p),1). There are no arbitrary comparison isomorphisms and no restriction, quasi-isomorphism or K-injectivity hypothesis.

source.place: Hom complexes, differential and precomposition; Tag 08DL for the restriction comparison.

proof.text: Adapt the already proved private cycle-pairing arguments of Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.HomologyEvaluationCycleExistence to an arbitrary small ringed site. Use the supplied differential identity to lift evaluation to K cycles, and prove separately that Hom boundaries and source boundaries evaluate to K boundaries. Apply HomologicalComplex.homologyIsCokernel in the Hom variable. In the source variable use SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv and CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit for tensorRight, a colimit-preserving left adjoint, to descend to source homology. This proves cyclePairing_descend, producing h and its cycle lift k with both factorization equations. All helpers are proved locally, with no new sorry.

Prove cyclePairing_naturality from the single supplied precomposition identity: first cancel homObjMap(identity,K.iCycles), which is monic because internal Hom is a right adjoint. The cycle factorization equations, cyclesMap_i and the component identity give d;Hom(cyclesMap q,identity)=cyclesMap Hom(q,K);k. Then cancel the epimorphism from Hom cycles to homology and the monomorphism Hom(L.homologyPi,identity). The latter follows by uncurrying and cancellation of the epimorphism tensorRight.map L.homologyPi. Rewrite both homology factorization equations and homologyPi_naturality to conclude g;Hom(H(q),identity)=Qmap;h. Repeat for p and f. No local section lifts or pointwise surjectivity are used.

Rewrite the two naturality equations into the desired roof identity. IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc cancels the inverse of Pmap against Pmap. The original statement and its only invertibility assumption are unchanged.

proof_origin.description: Generalized the proved categorical cycle evaluation helpers in HomologyEvaluationCycleExistence to a small ringed site; proved cycle and homology naturality by categorical mono/epi cancellation, and assembled the roof equation. Sources: Stacks 0A8X and 03EO.

theorem homologyEvaluation_roof_naturality
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {S : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R : Sheaf S CommRingCat.{u}}
    (A E L K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (π : ∀ (B M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
      (n a b : ℤ), a + n = b →
        ((homComplex (R := R) B M).X n ⟶
          SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (B.X a) (M.X b)))
    (hπdiff : ∀ (B M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
      (n m a b b' a' : ℤ) (_hnm : n + 1 = m)
      (hab : a + m = b) (hb' : a + n = b') (ha' : a' + n = b),
      (homComplex (R := R) B M).d n m ≫ π B M m a b hab =
        π B M n a b' hb' ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (M.d b' b) -
          n.negOnePow • (π B M n a' b ha' ≫
            SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (B.d a a') (𝟙 _)))
    (hπnat : ∀ (B B' M M' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
      (t : B' ⟶ B) (s : M ⟶ M') (n a b : ℤ) (hab : a + n = b),
      ((((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).map t.op).app M) ≫
          ((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op B')).map s).f n ≫ π B' M' n a b hab =
        π B M n a b hab ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (t.f a) (s.f b))
    (n : ℤ) (q : L ⟶ A) (p : L ⟶ E)
    [IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).map p.op).app K) n)] :
    let Q := homComplex (R := R) A K
    let P := homComplex (R := R) E K
    ∀ (g : Q.homology n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R)
        (A.homology (-n)) (K.homology 0))
      (d : Q.cycles n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (A.cycles (-n)) (K.cycles 0))
      (f : P.homology n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R)
        (E.homology (-n)) (K.homology 0))
      (c : P.cycles n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.cycles (-n)) (K.cycles 0)),
      d ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.iCycles 0) =
        Q.iCycles n ≫ π A K n (-n) 0 (by omega) ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (A.iCycles (-n)) (𝟙 _) →
      d ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.homologyπ 0) =
        Q.homologyπ n ≫ g ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (A.homologyπ (-n)) (𝟙 _) →
      c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.iCycles 0) =
        P.iCycles n ≫ π E K n (-n) 0 (by omega) ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.iCycles (-n)) (𝟙 _) →
      c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.homologyπ 0) =
        P.homologyπ n ≫ f ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.homologyπ (-n)) (𝟙 _) →
      g ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap q (-n)) (𝟙 _) =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).map q.op).app K) n ≫
          inv (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).map p.op).app K) n) ≫
          f ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap p (-n)) (𝟙 _)
